## Function Cut Units

The Functions and map groups of one Component as card units, in record order.

Behaviour: cutUnits(component, groups). A group none of whose Functions belongs to the Component is skipped (it is another Component's); a group naming some of its Functions and some it does not have → {ok: false, error: "group '<g>' names unknown Function '<first unknown>' next to '<first known>' of Component '<c>': a group names the Functions of one Component"}. Then, per Function in record order: not in a group → {id: slugName(its name), name: its name, functions: [it], isGroup: false}; in a group not placed yet → {id: slugName(the group's name), name: the group's name, functions: the group's Functions in record order, isGroup: true}, placed where its first Function stands. → {ok: true, units}.

- reads: Contour Map
- produces: Unit

## Function Parse Command

argv into one Command or a usage error; global --root and --pretty anywhere.

Behaviour: parseCommand(argv) scans argv left to right. A token starting with "--" is a flag: --pretty and --judge take no value; --root, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches, --slice-cap-bytes, --spec, --component, --map, --out take the next token whatever it is; any other flag (also --x=y) → "unknown flag: <t>"; a value flag as the last token → "flag <t> needs a value"; a flag seen twice → "flag <t> given twice", except --component, which repeats and keeps every value in argv order (the first such error in argv order wins). Every other token is a word. Then the command from the words: none → "no command (commands: deck check, plan, run)"; "run" → run; "plan" → plan; "deck" "check" → deck check; a first word scout, primer, review or report → NotYetError "command <word> is not available yet"; "deck" followed by add, status, reset or clear → NotYetError "command deck <w> is not available yet"; anything else → "unknown command: <words joined by a space>". More words than the command takes → "unexpected argument: <first extra>". Then, in this order: a flag the command does not take → "flag <f> does not apply to <command>" (deck check takes --root, --pretty, --deck, --slice-cap-bytes; run takes --root, --pretty, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches; plan takes --root, --pretty, --spec, --component, --map, --judge, --out), in argv order; plan without --spec → "missing --spec", else plan is done: {name: "plan", root, pretty, spec, components: the --component values ([] when none), map: the value or null, judge: --judge given, out: the value or null}; no --deck → "missing --deck"; run without --processor → "missing --processor"; for run a --run-id not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--run-id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')"; numbers in the order --slice-cap-bytes (deck check), --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches (run): digits only, ≥ 1 ("<f> must be a positive integer (got '<v>')"), --max-retry-batches ≥ 0 ("must be a non-negative integer"). Every failure is {ok: false, error: {error: {code: 4, kind: "UsageError" | "NotYetError", message}}}.
